name: Absolver
short_description: Wander a ruined land in a mask and build your own martial-arts style from moves you learn by fighting.
sources: oracle study 2026-10-23 (public knowledge, no store fetch, no game files)
summary: Wander a ruined land in a mask and build your own martial-arts style from moves you learn by fighting.

identity.core_loop: Explore, meet a fighter, duel in stances, learn the moves you blocked, arrange them into your own combat deck, fight better.
identity.ui_and_game_feel: Deliberate and dance-like; each stance flows into the next move in your deck.

hud_coverage.method: Oracle study from public knowledge of the game, in our own words; not yet measured on capture

information_grammar.note: Very little HUD: a small stance indicator and health. The fighter's body and stance tell you what comes next.

identity.art_direction: Faceted low-poly bodies and ruins in flat painted colour, with flowing cloth and masks.

rendering.signature: Faceted low-poly bodies and ruins in flat painted colour with soft fog; the detail is spent on cloth, masks and motion.
rendering.source: oracle rendering study 2026-10-23 (public knowledge, no captures, no game files)
rendering.lesson: Spend detail on what moves (cloth, masks) and keep the rest faceted and flat; animation then carries the beauty.

tricks: Martial-arts moves built as chains across four stances; each move ends in the stance the next one starts from
Custom Unreal animation system so designers could assemble decks of moves without code
Cloth and masks carry secondary motion on simple faceted bodies
motion.lesson: Moves that end where the next begins let players chain their own combos; secondary motion on cloth sells it.

sources.title: Unreal Engine interview: crafting a unique combat experience in Absolver

motion.source: oracle motion study 2026-10-23 (public talks, interviews and breakdowns; no game files)

identity.audio_mood: Ambient strings and wind; sharp, dry hit sounds.
identity.lessons_for_abbies_world: Let players compose their own fighting style from moves they collect: expression inside a fight. The body is the readout.
